sourceRegistryInvariant: Do not create/rekey source records; use exact existing production source UUID and URL.
rightsRationale: FDA states FDA-owned site text and graphics are public domain unless otherwise noted; external/third-party materials and marks excluded. This approval is restricted to the original HTML document at the exact URL, with no subresource downloads.

authorizationSemantics.collectorMayFetchOnlyIf: asset ID + source UUID + exact URL + method + MIME + rights/retention approval + current date + robots check all match AND production authorization enforcement is deployed
authorizationSemantics.robots: Respect current robots.txt and minimum 30-second delay between FDA requests; stop on 403/429 and unexpected redirects.
authorizationSemantics.redirectPolicy: Fail closed on redirect to a different URL until independently approved.
authorizationSemantics.archive: Preserve original HTTP response body bytes unchanged with SHA-256, fetch timestamp, source UUID, asset ID, provenance and immutable version history.
authorizationSemantics.retention: Private immutable preservation of approved FDA-authored HTML evidence while rights remain valid; quarantine/restrict access upon policy changes or takedown requests; no public redistribution; review every 30 days.
